crossRefs.note: They said to one another, “We are certainly guilty concerning our brother, in that we saw the distress of his soul…
Then Pharaoh called for Moses and Aaron in haste, and he said, “I have sinned against Yahweh your God, and against you.
Balaam said to Yahweh’s angel, “I have sinned; for I didn’t know that you stood in the way against me. Now therefore…
Saul said to Samuel, “I have sinned; for I have transgressed the commandment of Yahweh, and your words, because I…
Then he said, “I have sinned; yet please honor me now before the elders of my people, and before Israel, and come back…
If I have sinned, what do I do to you, you watcher of men? Why have you set me as a mark for you, so that I am a burden…
He sings before men, and says, ‘I have sinned, and perverted that which was right, and it didn’t profit me.
For I will declare my iniquity. I will be sorry for my sin.
saying, “I have sinned in that I betrayed innocent blood.” But they said, “What is that to us? You see to it.”

people.name: Achan
people.line: An Israelite who stole devoted things, causing Israel's defeat.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Joshua
people.line: Moses' assistant who led Israel into Canaan

translations.web: Achan answered Joshua, and said, “I have truly sinned against Yahweh, the God of Israel, and this is what I have done.
translations.bsb: “It is true,” Achan replied, “I have sinned against the LORD, the God of Israel. This is what I did:
translations.kjv: And Achan answered Joshua, and said, Indeed I have sinned against the LORD God of Israel, and thus and thus have I done:
translations.asv: And Achan answered Joshua, and said, Of a truth I have sinned against Jehovah, the God of Israel, and thus and thus have I done:
